shloka_text: तच्छ्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणेनोक्तं वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः । प्रत्युवाच महातेजाः प्रहसन्राघवो वचः ।। 7.87.1 ।।
transliteration: tacchrutvā lakṣmaṇenoktaṃ vākyaṃ vākyaviśāradaḥ | pratyuvāca mahātejāḥ prahasanrāghavo vacaḥ || 7.87.1 ||
translation: तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, उक्तं spoken, वाक्यं word, वाक्यविशारदः expert in speech, प्रत्युवाच replied, महातेजाः greatly effulgent, प्रहसन् smiling, राघवः Rama, वचः words.
explanation: Having heard the words spoken by Lakshmana, Rama, who was greatly effulgent and an expert in speech, replied with a smile.
comments: Rama agrees but first tells of King Ila, lord of Bahlika, who while hunting enters a region where Shiva, to please Parvati, has turned himself and all beings female, so that Ila and his men become women -- denied restoration of his manhood, Ila wins from Uma a compromise: to be a man one month and the woman Ila the next, with no memory of either state.

shloka_text: एवमेव नरश्रेष्ठ यथा वदसि लक्ष्मण । वृत्रघातमशेषेण वाजिमेधफलं च यत् ।। 7.87.2 ।।
transliteration: evameva naraśreṣṭha yathā vadasi lakṣmaṇa | vṛtraghātamaśeṣeṇa vājimedhaphalaṃ ca yat || 7.87.2 ||
translation: एवमेव exactly so, नरश्रेष्ठ O best among men, यथा as, वदसि you say, लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, वृत्रघातम् the slaying of Vritra, अशेषेण completely, वाजिमेधफलम् the fruit of Ashwamedha sacrifice, च and, यत् which.
explanation: Rama affirmed to Lakshmana, "O best among men, what you say is exactly true, regarding the complete slaying of Vritra and the fruit of the Ashwamedha sacrifice."

shloka_text: श्रूयते हि पुरा सौम्य कर्दमस्य प्रजापतेः । पुत्रो बाह्लीश्वरः श्रीमानिलो नाम महाशयाः ।। 7.87.3 ।।
transliteration: śrūyate hi purā saumya kardamasya prajāpateḥ | putro bāhlīśvaraḥ śrīmānilo nāma mahāśayāḥ || 7.87.3 ||
translation: श्रूयते it is heard, हि indeed, पुरा formerly, सौम्य O gentle one, कर्दमस्य of Kardama, प्रजापतेः the Prajapati, पुत्रः son, बाह्लीश्वरः lord of Bahlika, श्रीमान् glorious, इलः Ila, नाम named, महाशयाः of great mind.
explanation: O gentle one, it is indeed heard that formerly, there was a glorious son of Prajapati Kardama, named Ila, who was the lord of Bahlika and of great mind.

shloka_text: स राजा पृथिवीं सर्वां वशे कृत्वा सुधार्मिकः । राज्यं चैव नरव्याघ्र पुत्रवत्पर्यपालयत् ।। 7.87.4 ।।
transliteration: sa rājā pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ vaśe kṛtvā sudhārmikaḥ | rājyaṃ caiva naravyāghra putravatparyapālayat || 7.87.4 ||
translation: सः that, राजा king, पृथिवीं earth, सर्वां entire, वशे under control, कृत्वा having made, सुधार्मिकः very righteous, राज्यं kingdom, च and, एव indeed, नरव्याघ्र O tiger among men, पुत्रवत् like a son, पर्यपालयत् protected.
explanation: That very righteous king, having brought the entire earth under his control, protected his kingdom as if it were his own son, O tiger among men.

shloka_text: सुरैश्च परमोदारैर्दैतेयैश्च महाधनैः । नागराक्षसगन्धर्वैर्यक्षैश्च सुमहात्मभिः ।। 7.87.5 ।।
transliteration: suraiśca paramodārairdaiteyaiśca mahādhanaiḥ | nāgarākṣasagandharvairyakṣaiśca sumahātmabhiḥ || 7.87.5 ||
translation: सुरैः by gods, च and, परमोदारैः extremely generous, दैतेयैः by Daityas, च and, महाधनैः very wealthy, नागराक्षसगन्धर्वैः by Nagas, Rakshasas, and Gandharvas, यक्षैः by Yakshas, च and, सुमहात्मभिः very noble-minded.
explanation: He was revered by extremely generous gods, very wealthy Daityas, Nagas, Rakshasas, Gandharvas, and very noble-minded Yakshas.

shloka_text: पूज्यते नित्यशः सौम्य भयार्तै रघुनन्दन । अबिभ्यंश्च त्रयो लोकाः सरोषस्य महात्मनः ।। 7.87.6 ।।
transliteration: pūjyate nityaśaḥ saumya bhayārtai raghunandana | abibhyaṃśca trayo lokāḥ saroṣasya mahātmanaḥ || 7.87.6 ||
translation: पूज्यते is worshipped, नित्यशः constantly, सौम्य O gentle one, भयार्तैः by the fearful, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus, अबिभ्यंश्च and fearless, त्रयो लोकाः the three worlds, सरोषस्य of the wrathful, महात्मनः great soul.
explanation: O gentle Rama, O delight of the Raghus, this great and wrathful king is constantly worshipped by those afflicted with fear, and due to his power, the three worlds are fearless.

shloka_text: स राजा तादृशो ह्यासीद्धर्मे वीर्ये च निष्ठितः । बुद्ध्या च परमोदारो बाह्लीकेशो महायशाः ।। 7.87.7 ।।
transliteration: sa rājā tādṛśo hyāsīddharme vīrye ca niṣṭhitaḥ | buddhyā ca paramodāro bāhlīkeśo mahāyaśāḥ || 7.87.7 ||
translation: सः that, राजा king, तादृशः such, हि indeed, आसीत् was, धर्मे in righteousness, वीर्ये in valor, च and, निष्ठितः established, बुद्ध्या in intellect, च and, परमोदारः supremely noble, बाह्लीकेशः the lord of Bahlika, महायशाः greatly renowned.
explanation: That king, the lord of Bahlika, was indeed such a one, firmly established in righteousness and valor, supremely noble in intellect, and greatly renowned.

shloka_text: स प्रचक्रे महाबाहुर्मृगयां रुचिरे वने । चैत्रे मनोरमे मासि सभृत्यबलवाहनः ।। 7.87.8 ।।
transliteration: sa pracakre mahābāhurmṛgayāṃ rucire vane | caitre manorame māsi sabhṛtyabalavāhanaḥ || 7.87.8 ||
translation: सः he, प्रचक्रे undertook, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed, मृगयाम् hunting, रुचिरे in a beautiful, वने forest, चैत्रे in Chaitra, मनोरमे delightful, मासि month, सभृत्यबलवाहनः with servants, army, and conveyances.
explanation: The mighty-armed king undertook a hunt in a beautiful forest during the delightful month of Chaitra, accompanied by his servants, army, and conveyances.

shloka_text: प्रजघ्ने च नृपो ऽरण्ये मृगाञ्छतसहस्रशः । हत्वैव तृप्तिर्नाभूच्च राज्ञस्तस्य महात्मनः ।। 7.87.9 ।।
transliteration: prajaghne ca nṛpo 'raṇye mṛgāñchatasahasraśaḥ | hatvaiva tṛptirnābhūcca rājñastasya mahātmanaḥ || 7.87.9 ||
translation: प्रजघ्ने killed, च and, नृपः the king, अरण्ये in the forest, मृगान् animals, शतसहस्रशः by hundreds of thousands, हत्वा having killed, एव even, तृप्तिः satisfaction, न not, अभूत् was, च and, राज्ञः of the king, तस्य that, महात्मनः great soul.
explanation: And the king killed hundreds of thousands of animals in the forest, yet even after killing so many, that great-souled king was not satisfied.

shloka_text: नानामृगाणामयुतं वध्यमानं महात्मना । यत्र जातो माहासेनस्तं देशमुपचक्रमे ।। 7.87.10 ।।
transliteration: nānāmṛgāṇāmayutaṃ vadhyamānaṃ mahātmanā | yatra jāto māhāsenastaṃ deśamupacakrame || 7.87.10 ||
translation: नानामृगाणाम् of various animals, अयुतम् ten thousand, वध्यमानम् being killed, महात्मना by the great soul, यत्र where, जातः was born, माहासेनः Mahasena, तम् that, देशम् region, उपचक्रमे approached.
explanation: While ten thousand animals of various kinds were being killed by the great-souled king, he approached that region where Mahasena (Kartikeya) was born.

shloka_text: तस्मिन्प्रदेशे देवेश शैलराजसुतां हरः । रमयामास दुर्धर्षः सर्वैरनुचरैः सह ।। 7.87.11 ।।
transliteration: tasminpradeśe deveśa śailarājasutāṃ haraḥ | ramayāmāsa durdharṣaḥ sarvairanucaraiḥ saha || 7.87.11 ||
translation: तस्मिन्प्रदेशे in that region, देवेश the lord of gods, शैलराजसुतां the daughter of the king of mountains, हरः Hara, रमयामास made to sport, दुर्धर्षः the unassailable one, सर्वैः with all, अनुचरैः attendants, सह together.
explanation: In that region, the unassailable Hara, the lord of gods, sported with Parvati, the daughter of the king of mountains, accompanied by all his attendants.

shloka_text: कृत्वा स्त्रीरूपमात्मानमुमेशो गोपतिध्वजः । देव्याः प्रियचिकीर्षुः संस्तस्मिन्पर्वतनिर्झरे ।। 7.87.12 ।।
transliteration: kṛtvā strīrūpamātmānamumeśo gopatidhvajaḥ | devyāḥ priyacikīrṣuḥ saṃstasminparvatanirjhare || 7.87.12 ||
translation: कृत्वा having made, स्त्रीरूपम् a female form, आत्मानम् himself, उमेशः the lord of Uma, गोपतिध्वजः one whose banner has a bull, देव्याः of the goddess, प्रियचिकीर्षुः desirous of doing what is pleasing, सन् being, तस्मिन् in that, पर्वतनिर्झरे mountain stream.
explanation: Desirous of pleasing the goddess, Shiva, the lord of Uma whose banner bears a bull, transformed himself into a female form in that mountain stream.

shloka_text: ये तु तत्र वनोद्देशे सत्त्वाः पुरुषवादिनः । वृक्षाः पुरुषनामानस्ते ऽभवन् स्त्रीजनास्तदा ।। 7.87.13 ।।
transliteration: ye tu tatra vanoddeśe sattvāḥ puruṣavādinaḥ | vṛkṣāḥ puruṣanāmānaste 'bhavan strījanāstadā || 7.87.13 ||
translation: ये those who, तु indeed, तत्र there, वनोद्देशे in the forest region, सत्त्वाः beings, पुरुषवादिनः called males, वृक्षाः trees, पुरुषनामानः named as males, ते they, अभवन् became, स्त्रीजनाः women, तदा then.
explanation: Then, all the male beings and trees with male names in that forest region transformed into women.

shloka_text: यच्च किञ्चन तत्सर्वं नारीसञ्ज्ञं बभूव ह । एतस्मिन्नन्तरे राजा स इलः कर्दमात्मजः । निघ्नन्मृगसहस्राणि तं देशमुपचक्रमे ।। 7.87.14 ।।
transliteration: yacca kiñcana tatsarvaṃ nārīsañjñaṃ babhūva ha | etasminnantare rājā sa ilaḥ kardamātmajaḥ | nighnanmṛgasahasrāṇi taṃ deśamupacakrame || 7.87.14 ||
translation: यत् whatever, च and, किञ्चन anything, तत् that, सर्वम् all, नारीसञ्ज्ञं having a female form, बभूव became, ह indeed. एतस्मिन् in this, अन्तरे interval, राजा king, सः that, इलः Ila, कर्दमात्मजः son of Kardama, निघ्नन् killing, मृगसहस्राणि thousands of deer, तम् that, देशम् region, उपचक्रमे approached.
explanation: Indeed, everything there became female, and in the meantime, King Ila, the son of Kardama, entered that region while hunting thousands of deer.

shloka_text: स दृष्ट्वा स्त्रीकृतं सर्वं सव्यालमृगपक्षकम् । आत्मनं स्त्रीकृतं चैव सानुगं रघुनन्दन ।। 7.87.15 ।।
transliteration: sa dṛṣṭvā strīkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ savyālamṛgapakṣakam | ātmanaṃ strīkṛtaṃ caiva sānugaṃ raghunandana || 7.87.15 ||
translation: सः he, दृष्ट्वा having seen, स्त्रीकृतं made into a female, सर्वम् everything, सव्यालमृगपक्षकम् with wild animals, deer, and birds, आत्मानं himself, स्त्रीकृतं made into a female, च and, एव indeed, सानुगं with his followers, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus.
explanation: O delight of the Raghus, upon seeing everything—including wild animals, deer, and birds—transformed into females, and himself along with his followers also turned into women, he was astonished.

shloka_text: तस्य दुःखं महच्चासीद्दृष्ट्वा ऽ ऽत्मानं तथागतम् । उमापतेश्च तत्कर्म ज्ञात्वा त्रासमुपागमत् ।। 7.87.16 ।।
transliteration: tasya duḥkhaṃ mahaccāsīddṛṣṭvā ' 'tmānaṃ tathāgatam | umāpateśca tatkarma jñātvā trāsamupāgamat || 7.87.16 ||
translation: तस्य tasya, his, दुःखं duḥkhaṃ, sorrow, महत् mahat, great, च ca, and, आसीत् āsīt, was, दृष्ट्वा dṛṣṭvā, having seen, आत्मानं ātmānaṃ, himself, तथागतम् tathāgatam, in that state, उमापतेः umāpateḥ, of the lord of Uma (Shiva), च ca, and, तत् tat, that, कर्म karma, deed, ज्ञात्वा jñātvā, having known, त्रासम् trāsam, fear, उपागमत् upāgamat, he attained.
explanation: Seeing himself transformed and realizing that this was the deed of Lord Shiva, he was overcome with great sorrow and fear.

shloka_text: ततो देवं महात्मानं शितिकण्ठं कपर्दिनम् । जगाम शरणं राजा सभृत्यबलवाहनः ।। 7.87.17 ।।
transliteration: tato devaṃ mahātmānaṃ śitikaṇṭhaṃ kapardinam | jagāma śaraṇaṃ rājā sabhṛtyabalavāhanaḥ || 7.87.17 ||
translation: ततः tataḥ, then, देवं devaṃ, to the god, महात्मानं mahātmānaṃ, the great-souled, शितिकण्ठं śitikaṇṭhaṃ, blue-necked, कपर्दिनम् kapardinam, one with matted hair, जगाम jagāma, went, शरणं śaraṇaṃ, for refuge, राजा rājā, the king, सभृत्यबलवाहनः sabhṛtyabalavāhanaḥ, with his servants, army, and vehicles.
explanation: Then, the king, along with his servants, army, and vehicles, went to seek refuge with the great-souled, blue-necked, matted-haired god (Shiva).

shloka_text: ततः प्रहस्य वरदः सह देव्या महेश्वरः । प्रजापतिसुतं वाक्यमुवाच वरदः स्वयम् ।। 7.87.18 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ prahasya varadaḥ saha devyā maheśvaraḥ | prajāpatisutaṃ vākyamuvāca varadaḥ svayam || 7.87.18 ||
translation: ततः tataḥ, then, प्रहस्य prahasya, having laughed, वरदः varadaḥ, the bestower of boons, सह saha, with, देव्या devyā, the goddess, महेश्वरः maheśvaraḥ, the great lord (Shiva), प्रजापतिसुतं prajāpatisutaṃ, to the son of Prajapati, वाक्यम् vākyam, words, उवाच uvāca, spoke, वरदः varadaḥ, the bestower of boons, स्वयम् svayam, himself.
explanation: Then, the great lord Maheśvara, the bestower of boons, laughed with the goddess and himself spoke these words to the son of Prajapati.

shloka_text: उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ राजर्षे कार्दमेय महाबल । पुरुषत्वमृते सौम्य वरं वरय सुव्रत ।। 7.87.19 ।।
transliteration: uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha rājarṣe kārdameya mahābala | puruṣatvamṛte saumya varaṃ varaya suvrata || 7.87.19 ||
translation: उत्तिष्ठ uttiṣṭha, arise, उत्तिष्ठ uttiṣṭha, arise, राजर्षे rājarṣe, O royal sage, कार्दमेय kārdameya, O son of Kardama, महाबल mahābala, O mighty one, पुरुषत्वम् puruṣatvam, manhood, ऋते ṛte, except for, सौम्य saumya, O gentle one, वरम् varam, a boon, वरय varaya, choose, सुव्रत suvrata, O one of good vows.
explanation: Lord Shiva commanded, "Arise, arise, O royal sage, O son of Kardama, O mighty one; O gentle one, O one of good vows, choose any boon except for manhood."

shloka_text: ततः स राजा दुःखार्तः प्रत्याख्यातो महात्मना । न च जग्राह स्त्रीभूतो वरमन्यं सुरोत्तमात् ।। 7.87.20 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ sa rājā duḥkhārtaḥ pratyākhyāto mahātmanā | na ca jagrāha strībhūto varamanyaṃ surottamāt || 7.87.20 ||
translation: ततः tataḥ, then, सः saḥ, that, राजा rājā, king, दुःखार्तः duḥkhārtaḥ, afflicted by sorrow, प्रत्याख्यातः pratyākhyātaḥ, rejected, महात्मना mahātmanā, by the great-souled one, न na, not, च ca, and, जग्राह jagrāha, accepted, स्त्रीभूतो strībhūto, having become a woman, वरम् varam, a boon, अन्यम् anyam, other, सुरोत्तमात् surottamāt, from the best of gods.
explanation: Then, that king, afflicted by sorrow and rejected by the great-souled one, did not accept any other boon from the best of gods, having become a woman.

shloka_text: ततः शोकेन महता शैलराजसुतां नृपः । प्रणिपत्य ह्युमां देवीं सर्वेणैवान्तरात्मना ।। 7.87.21 ।।
transliteration: tataḥ śokena mahatā śailarājasutāṃ nṛpaḥ | praṇipatya hyumāṃ devīṃ sarveṇaivāntarātmanā || 7.87.21 ||
translation: ततः then, शोकेन with sorrow, महता great, शैलराजसुतां to the daughter of the king of mountains, नृपः the king, प्रणिपत्य having bowed down, हि indeed, उमां Uma, देवीं to the goddess, सर्वेण with all, एव indeed, अन्तरात्मना with his inner self.
explanation: Then, overwhelmed by great sorrow, the king bowed down to the goddess Uma, the daughter of the king of mountains, with his entire heart and soul.

shloka_text: ईशे वराणां वरदे लोकानामसि भामिनी । अमोघदर्शने देवी भज सौम्येन चक्षुषा ।। 7.87.22 ।।
transliteration: īśe varāṇāṃ varade lokānāmasi bhāminī | amoghadarśane devī bhaja saumyena cakṣuṣā || 7.87.22 ||
translation: ईशे You are the mistress, वराणां of boons, वरदे O giver of boons, लोकानाम् of the worlds, असि you are, भामिनी O radiant one, अमोघदर्शने O one whose sight is unfailing, देवी O goddess, भज look upon, सौम्येन with a gentle, चक्षुषा eye.
explanation: O radiant goddess, giver of boons, you are the mistress of boons and the worlds, and your sight is unfailing; please look upon me with a gentle eye.

shloka_text: हृद्गतं तस्य राजर्षेर्विज्ञाय हरसन्निधौ । प्रत्युवाच शुभं वाक्यं देवी रुद्रस्य संमता ।। 7.87.23 ।।
transliteration: hṛdgataṃ tasya rājarṣervijñāya harasannidhau | pratyuvāca śubhaṃ vākyaṃ devī rudrasya saṃmatā || 7.87.23 ||
translation: हृद्गतं that which is in the heart, तस्य his, राजर्षेः of the royal sage, विज्ञाय having known, हरसन्निधौ in the presence of Hara, प्रत्युवाच replied, शुभं auspicious, वाक्यं words, देवी the goddess, रुद्रस्य of Rudra, संमता approved by.
explanation: Having understood the desire in the heart of that royal sage, the goddess, who was dear to Rudra, replied with auspicious words in the presence of Hara.

shloka_text: अर्धस्य देवो वरदो वरार्धस्य तव ह्यहम् । तस्मादर्धं गृहाण त्वं स्त्रीपुंसोर्यावदिच्छसि ।। 7.87.24 ।।
transliteration: ardhasya devo varado varārdhasya tava hyaham | tasmādardhaṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ strīpuṃsoryāvadicchasi || 7.87.24 ||
translation: अर्धस्य of half, देवो the god, वरदो is the giver of boons, वरार्धस्य of the other half of the boon, तव to you, हि indeed, अहम् I, तस्मात् therefore, अर्धं half, गृहाण take, त्वं you, स्त्रीपुंसोः of male and female, यावत् as much as, इच्छसि you desire.
explanation: The goddess declared that Shiva grants half of the boons, and she grants the other half, therefore the king should take as much of the male and female aspect as he desires.

shloka_text: तदद्भुततरं श्रुत्वा देव्या वरमनुत्तमम् । सम्प्रहृष्टमना भूत्वा राजा वाक्यमथाब्रवीत् ।। 7.87.25 ।।
transliteration: tadadbhutataraṃ śrutvā devyā varamanuttamam | samprahṛṣṭamanā bhūtvā rājā vākyamathābravīt || 7.87.25 ||
translation: तत् that, अद्भुततरं most wonderful, श्रुत्वा having heard, देव्या from the goddess, वरम् boon, अनुत्तमम् unsurpassed, सम्प्रहृष्टमना with a greatly delighted mind, भूत्वा having become, राजा the king, वाक्यम् words, अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Having heard that most wonderful and unsurpassed boon from the goddess, the king became greatly delighted and then spoke.

shloka_text: यदि देवि प्रसन्ना मे रूपेणाप्रतिमा भुवि । मासं स्त्रीत्वमुपासित्वा मासं स्यां पुरुषः पुनः ।। 7.87.26 ।।
transliteration: yadi devi prasannā me rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi | māsaṃ strītvamupāsitvā māsaṃ syāṃ puruṣaḥ punaḥ || 7.87.26 ||
translation: यदि if, देवि O Goddess, प्रसन्ना pleased, मे with me, रूपेण in form/beauty, अप्रतिमा unequalled, भुवि on earth, मासम् for a month, स्त्रीत्वम् womanhood, उपासित्वा having experienced, मासम् for a month, स्याम् may I be, पुरुषः a man, पुनः again.
explanation: O Goddess, if you are pleased with me, who is unequalled in beauty on earth, then may I experience womanhood for one month and then become a man again for another month.

shloka_text: ईप्सितं तस्य विज्ञाय देवी सुरुचिरानना । प्रत्युवाच शुभं वाक्यमेवमेव भविष्यति ।। 7.87.27 ।।
transliteration: īpsitaṃ tasya vijñāya devī surucirānanā | pratyuvāca śubhaṃ vākyamevameva bhaviṣyati || 7.87.27 ||
translation: ईप्सितम् the desired wish, तस्य his, विज्ञाय having understood, देवी the Goddess, सुरुचिरानना with a very beautiful face, प्रत्युवाच replied, शुभम् auspicious, वाक्यम् words, एवमेव exactly so, भविष्यति it shall be.
explanation: Understanding his wish, the Goddess with a very beautiful face replied with auspicious words, saying, 'It shall be exactly so.'

shloka_text: राजन्पुरुषभूतस्त्वं स्त्रीभावं न स्मरिष्यसि । स्त्रीभूतश्च परं मासं न स्मरिष्यसि पौरुषम् ।। 7.87.28 ।।
transliteration: rājanpuruṣabhūtastvaṃ strībhāvaṃ na smariṣyasi | strībhūtaśca paraṃ māsaṃ na smariṣyasi pauruṣam || 7.87.28 ||
translation: राजन् O King, पुरुषभूतः having become a man, त्वम् you, स्त्रीभावम् the state of being a woman, न not, स्मरिष्यसि will remember, स्त्रीभूतः having become a woman, च and, परम् next, मासम् month, न not, स्मरिष्यसि will remember, पौरुषम् manhood.
explanation: O King, when you become a man, you will not remember your state as a woman, and when you become a woman for the next month, you will not remember your manhood.

shloka_text: एवं स राजा पुरुषो मासं भूत्वाथ कार्दमिः । त्रैलोक्यसुन्दरी नारी मासमेकमिला ऽभवत् ।। 7.87.29 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ sa rājā puruṣo māsaṃ bhūtvātha kārdamiḥ | trailokyasundarī nārī māsamekamilā 'bhavat || 7.87.29 ||
translation: एवम् thus, सः that, राजा king, पुरुषः a man, मासम् for a month, भूत्वा having been, अथ then, कार्दमिः the son of Kardama, त्रैलोक्यसुन्दरी beautiful in the three worlds, नारी a woman, मासम् for a month, एकम् one, इला Ila, अभवत् became.
explanation: Thus, that King Ila, the son of Kardama, having been a man for one month, then became Ila, a woman beautiful in the three worlds, for another month. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे सप्ताशीतितमः सर्गः ।। 87 ।। Thus ends the eighty-seventh sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
